aboutHeading: You cannot see your own roof
about:
That is the whole problem with this trade. You are trusting whoever climbs up there to tell you the truth about something you will never look at yourself, and plenty of people in this business know it.

So we photograph everything. Every problem area, before we touch it, and the same spots again when the work is done. It goes to you with the written estimate, and if something can safely wait a year we will tell you that rather than sell you a roof.

The estimate is free and there is no charge for coming out. If the number is wrong for you, keep the photos — you will need them for the next quote anyway.
